pageHero.heroTitle1: Empowering Grassroots Communities in Uganda Through
pageHero.heroDescription: Partnership for Integrated Development Uganda (PID) is a registered non-governmental organization dedicated to improving lives of vulnerable youth, children, and women through community-led solutions.

pageAbout.aboutParagraph1: Partnership for Integrated Development Uganda (PID) was established in 2010 as a community-driven initiative in Kitintale, Kampala. Formally registered under NGO Registration No. INDR177427311NB, PID works hand-in-hand with local leaders, schools, and families.
pageAbout.aboutParagraph2: Our holistic framework integrates sports for development, primary healthcare access, environmental protection, and economic empowerment to break generational poverty cycles across Uganda.
pageAbout.aboutMissionText: To foster inclusive community development through grassroots partnerships, sports engagement, healthcare access, and climate resilience.
pageAbout.aboutVisionText: A resilient Ugandan society where youth, children, and women thrive with dignity, equal opportunities, and sustainable livelihoods.

pagePillars.pillarsSubtitle: Four interconnected program areas delivering measurable social impact across Uganda's urban and rural communities.

pageImpact.impactSubtitle: PID is committed to transparent, data-led learning that tracks meaningful community outcomes.

pagePartners.partnersSubtitle: PID works with government, schools, communities and development partners to extend sustainable impact.

pageOpportunities.opportunitiesSubtitle: Volunteer, apply for a mentored internship, sponsor a programme or partner with PID.

services.title: Youth Sports & Talent Development
services.description: Providing football equipment, coaching academies, and life-skills tournaments for over 1,200 young athletes in Kitintale and Nakawa.

services.title: Community Primary Healthcare Outreach
services.description: Mobile immunization clinics, reproductive health education, hygiene kits, and WASH infrastructure in informal settlements.

services.title: Youth Digital Literacy & Livelihoods
services.description: Hands-on computer training, financial literacy workshops, and micro-business mentorship for young women and school dropouts.

services.title: Climate Action & Tree Planting Nurseries
services.description: Establishment of indigenous tree nurseries, school eco-clubs, and community waste-to-value composting projects.

packages.title: Youth Sports Coaching Fellowship
packages.description: Train local grassroots soccer coaches, facilitate life-skills sessions, and co-organize community tournaments with local schools.

packages.title: Community Health & WASH Outreach
packages.description: Assist local medical workers in mobile health screening clinics, maternal nutrition workshops, and hygiene kit distributions.

packages.title: Eco-Schools & Climate Action Expedition
packages.description: Plant indigenous trees with local primary schools, set up school gardens, and explore Ugandan wildlife conservation parks.

blogPosts.summary: Over 1,200 young boys and girls participated in the 2026 Kitintale Peace & Talent Tournament, combining soccer matches with health sensitization.

blogPosts.title: Launching 5 New Digital Literacy Labs for Women Entrepreneurs
blogPosts.author: Programs Director
blogPosts.summary: PID Uganda officially commissioned five community solar-powered computer stations targeting young women business owners.

testimonials.name: Sarah Namukasa
testimonials.comment: PID Uganda transformed my son's life through sports and discipline. He now stays focused on his studies and has developed true leadership skills.

testimonials.name: David Ochieng
testimonials.comment: Working with PID Uganda on community health outreach in Kitintale was the most rewarding experience of my life. The team's passion is inspiring.
